data.name: Charmain
data.gender_notes: Charmain is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Greek 'charmatos' meaning 'grace, attraction', and 'aina' meaning 'pain, affliction' or 'image'. Charmain signifies the strength and grace that comes from overcoming hardships. The name Charmain carries the meaning “Graceful strength” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Charmain usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful strength and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Divine guidance and grace in times of struggle.
data.etymology: Charmain belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Graceful strength.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Charmain total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
